title: Regularity Analysis and Tensor Neural Network Methods for Quasiperiodic Elliptic Equations
summary: This paper investigates quasiperiodic elliptic equations using a well-established projection method, by which the original problem is reformulated as a degenerate periodic variational problem defined on a higher-dimensional torus. The main analytical difficulty lies in the degeneracy of the projected torus problem: the variational formulation is coercive in the projected Sobolev spaces induced by the projection matrix, but fails to be coercive with respect to the standard Sobolev norm.
